retained: Original game.js seeded terrain/noise, procedural block atlas, face-culling AO chunk mesher, sun/moon lighting/shadows and original oak() tree algorithm. Original bundled Three 0.180 renderer retained. Added rawSet/rebuildAll/blockMesh expose those mechanisms; tree blocks are produced by oak and displayed using the original atlas UV mapping.
rewritten: New sculpted block hillside/bare patch, a new garden robot and planting arm, seed placement, tree growth by scaling source-generated oak geometry, and a deterministic observation camera.
assetsAndLicense: MIT game code. Procedural textures and original vendor bundle retained with license notices; no downloaded model/texture/character assets.
boundary: Original game port is deliberately bounded to a 4x4 chunk cinematic world. No claim that the full playable 224x72x224 game or block-edit interface is integrated; tree growth is new geometry scaling, not a biological simulation.
